name: SignCell, SignChain, SignGraph and SignCraft as the data, code, networking and systems the Group's software builds on
asks:
signcell is meant to be the app of computer-data, signchain the app of computer-code, signgraph the app of comptuer-networking, and signcraft the app of computer-systems.

Yet it feels as though you still never actually gave any development attention to those, getting them where they need to be, having the caaabilities they need, moving the capabilities they don't need out of them and into more appropriate packages.

[2026-09-25] I want you to tell me what SignCell currently does, because I suspect most of what it does should actually be owned by other packages, and *no one* is actually providing the capabilities that SignCell actually should: the data structure of our semioitic cell.

[2026-10-04] SignStuff was never meant to like, enter the repo as a word, a file, or anything. Not a directory, nothing. Just a shorthand *I* can use to avoid saying "SignCell, SignChain, SignGraph, SignCraft" every time.

[2026-10-09] SIGNCHAIN MEANT TO BEAT LANGCHAIN / SIGHGRAPH MEANT TO BE LANGGRPAH

met-when.command: sh -c 'for t in signcell signchain signgraph signcraft; do test -f lib/emsenn/services/561-group/services/engineering-services-section/services/computer-engineering-services-section/content/text/glossary/terms/$t.md || exit 1; done'
sh -c '! git ls-files | grep -v /leader-utterances/ | grep -i -q signstuff'

x-provenance.recorded-by: Red Cup Engineer Senior (development pass signstuff-substrate of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus)
x-provenance.basis: The Leader's utterances to the Group's agents, read from the leader-utterances record in the emsenn section. The asks field quotes them; the requirements are their EARS rendering and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: The Group's software is built on four coherent libraries, SignCell, SignChain, SignGraph and SignCraft, which are its applications of computer data, code, networking and systems.

requirements.says: SignCell shall provide the semiotic cell's data structure and the methods that all computational data in the house shares.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-25: "no one is actually providing the capabilities that SignCell actually should: the data structure of our semioitic cell."

requirements.says: SignChain shall provide the logic structures and methods that all computational code in the house shares, as the bilattice of knowledge order and truth order that forms evidence.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-23: "signchain the app of computer-code"; the 2026-09-23 ecosystem note.

requirements.says: SignGraph shall provide the graph structures and methods that SignCells and SignChains form.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-23: "signgraph the app of comptuer-networking".

requirements.says: SignCraft shall compose SignCell, SignChain and SignGraph into the engine on which the Group's systems are built.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-23: "signcraft the app of computer-systems".

requirements.says: Each Sign library shall hold only the capabilities its own layer shares.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-23: "having the caaabilities they need, moving the capabilities they don't need out of them and into more appropriate packages."

requirements.says: Each Group package that handles data, code, networking or systems shall build on the Sign library of its layer instead of carrying its own implementation of that library's capability.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-26: "look at how what you're using doesn't use signcell, chain, graph, craft, or ANY software that it might should use"; 2026-10-09: "everything on signcell et al".

requirements.says: The repository shall not use "SignStuff" as the name of a record, file, directory or package.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-10-04: "SignStuff was never meant to like, enter the repo as a word, a file, or anything. Not a directory, nothing."

requirements.says: The Sign libraries shall be written in JavaScript without a TypeScript toolchain.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-24: "we should either have typescript installed, or, not be using typescript (preferred)".

requirements.says: SignChain shall carry the chained model and tool calls of agent work in the role LangChain plays.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-10-09: "SIGNCHAIN MEANT TO BEAT LANGCHAIN".

requirements.says: SignGraph shall carry agent graphs, their steps and their state in the role LangGraph plays.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-10-09: "SIGHGRAPH MEANT TO BE LANGGRPAH".

requirements.says: SignCraft shall carry the processor's primitive operation, in the role AND plays for boolean computers, derived from the house's logic and metaphysics.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-28: "a central part of our CPU the way AND is for boolean computers ... this stuff SHOULD be implemented using the logic, metaphysics".

requirements.says: Horsetail shall evaluate its LISP-style programs through SignCraft.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-26: "Horsetail is meant to be the 'let users write LISP-style syntax and interpret those programs,' which probably puts it downstream of signcraft".

requirements.says: Each record under a section's data/records directory shall be written and read by the Group software that owns its form.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-10-08: "too many handwritten data/records/*/ everywhere, it's very difficutl and makes you and other agents keep hadnwriting json in a vicious cycle"; data bloat makes "things actually being signcell, signchain, signgraph, signcraft, etc., very very hard".

conditions.says: Glossary terms for SignCell, SignChain, SignGraph and SignCraft exist in this section and state each library's layer.
No Sign library declares a TypeScript dependency or tsconfig.
A census of the house finds each Sign capability implemented once, in its library.
The specification of SignChain and SignGraph names the LangChain and LangGraph capabilities each meets and beats.
The SignCraft specification names the primitive operation and the Obsmetrologia result it rests on.
Each data/records form has a reader and writer in Group software.

board-opening.context: Theory: the Leader's 2026-09-23 software ecosystem note (Layer 0 substrate, Layer 1 systems), the 2026-09-04 shared semantic architecture specification, and the 2026-10-02 note on the libraries against Obsmetrologia. Specification note: content/text/documents/articles/notes/2026/10/10/2026-10-10-note-on-the-four-sign-libraries-as-data-code-networking-and-systems.md. The packages today sit at lib/signstuff/{signcell,signchain,signgraph,signcraft,signstuff-evm}, which R7 makes drift. Paths that still carry the shorthand on 2026-10-10: the lib/signstuff/ directory and its README, the signstuff-evm package, the signcraft package description, and the requirement id non-llm-logical-inference-model-on-signstuff. The leader-utterances record is excluded from the check because its pass ids are the record's own index.
